authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.
authorReview.targetDuration: About one minute at an unhurried conversational pace with real pauses; measure after recording.
authorReview.emotion: Concrete recognition, thoughtful tension and open curiosity; no melodramatic mystery or inflated promise.

notes: Replaced persistent-worker and coherent-direction jargon with files, history, review and finishing a task. Kept AssistOS clearly a proposed workplace rather than promising available functionality.
Every spoken sentence independently checked against the canonical English source for clear purpose, intended viewer response, source fidelity and natural spoken wording.
All scenes remain compact, with one sentence per clip and specific restrained delivery directions. Viewer responses are editorial intentions, not results from audience testing.

sentenceIntentions.text: Your AI finished the chat, but did it finish the work?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Distinguish a finished conversation from completed work.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize a frustrating gap in everyday AI use.

sentenceIntentions.text: AssistOS explores a proposed workplace where people and AI workers can keep a project moving together.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Identify the proposal and its purpose.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Know this book explores continuing human-AI collaboration.

sentenceIntentions.text: A document needs revising, a piece of research needs checking, or a code change needs review.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Show familiar tasks before discussing architecture.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Picture a useful assignment from their own work.

sentenceIntentions.text: The files and earlier decisions should still be there when the next task begins.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand why files and decisions must outlast a chat.

sentenceIntentions.text: The book asks how conversation, useful tools, and shared projects could fit together.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Become curious about how the pieces could work together.

sentenceIntentions.text: You would be able to follow the work, interrupt it, and check what actually changed.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make human control tangible while preserving proposal tense.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Imagine delegating work while retaining a way to check it.

sentenceIntentions.text: It also examines what must survive when a model or service is replaced.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Notice the risk of losing work when technology changes.

sentenceIntentions.text: For anyone tired of restarting the same conversation, the next question is how to make the work last.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Invite reading through a familiar unmet need.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want a better way to continue a project without starting over.
